title: Street tape: a Japanese street-fashion city game's official-site grammar - light grey, one acid yellow-green, black fine stripes, rounded slabs with one 49-degree cut, a film strip
summary: Light grey ground, one acid yellow-green as the only strong colour (15-22% of a section), black fine-stripe bands and big rounded slabs that all share one 49-degree cut, a three-line section title (ultra-black CJK, condensed Latin caps, a giant condensed two-digit number), a right-edge vertical pager, black capsule controls with a grey ring, and a film strip crossing between sections.

provenance.case: replay-ward (回放街区 REPLAY WARD): an original one-page official site (home, agents, media, news, archive, features; 1920 and 390 wide) and two in-game screens (agent detail, limited banner) built on the grammar, every character and picture a sized placeholder frame with a drawn silhouette.
provenance.lineage: The official-site grammar of Japanese street-fashion urban action games (2020s): a light-grey page, one acid ink, stripe bands and rounded slabs cut at one angle, numbered sections, a side pager. Read and measured on an owner-supplied reference board of six screenshots that stays private and is not shipped. Borrowed: the grammar and the measured proportions. Never borrowed: any name, logo, wordmark, character, mascot, city, slogan, picture or the board's own logo shape.
provenance.borrow: Borrow grammar, never assets. Every name, logo, character, headline and picture in the case and the templates is our own (回放街区, 唐小满, 沈蔓, 夜频电台); characters are sized placeholder frames with a drawn silhouette, waiting for original art from an image-generation task sheet.
provenance.rounds: One round, iterated by eye before the first check. template check --browser first pass: 54 findings over 9 pages (6 sections at 1920 x 1080, the mobile page at 390, two in-game screens): 32 glyph-coverage (mixed CJK and Latin set in the Latin face), 8 text-overlap (the logo lockup), 10 mixed-colour units (a capsule icon measured against its capsule), 3 on the ghost letters, 1 small label contrast; final 0. fonts query --style gothic --weight 900 covers all 524 characters of the copy.
measured: One cut angle: 49 degrees, not 45 (the white container's edge, the acid slab's edge and the stripe direction each measure dx/dy 0.86-0.87 on the board).

Acid #D8FA00 on the board (mode of 180 k pixels); the case and the pack use #D4FF00. Page grey #EFEFEF, stripes #0A0A0A lines on #222122 at a 13.2 px horizontal pitch (10 px across the stripe), top bar #000 66 px high.
Area per section (2 px sampling): acid 15-22%, dark (black and stripes) 24-39%; one section is grey-led with acid 4%.

Section title ink heights CJK : Latin : number = 45 : 19 : 115-130 px (1 : 0.42 : 2.6-2.9); 10 px and 20 px gaps; left edge at 15% of the width, right-aligned titles end 130 px from the right edge; sections alternate left and right.

Slab corner radius about 48 px; current-page capsule 103 x 35; acid CTA capsule 93 x 33; 'more' capsule 173 x 44 inside a 6 px grey ring; news card 705 x 354 with about 28 px corners; pager bar 46 px wide.
64 px: with the logos masked the six sections read as the grammar beside the board and apart from the six earlier game cases (acid-print-hud is the nearest: dark, not grey-led).

fonts.resolve: fonts query --text-file <all copy> --style gothic --weight 900 resolves Noto Sans SC (the case's query: 524 characters, none missing); Anton and Oswald are Latin only (fonts measure --path), so mixed CJK and Latin strings go to head or body, never num or label (32 of the case's first-pass findings were exactly that).
fonts.licence: All roles use SIL OFL 1.1 fonts.
fonts.note: Fonts are named, not bundled. --font-dir <dir> reads coverage and embeds the faces.

grammar: One diagonal: every cut, slab edge and stripe runs at 49 degrees from horizontal; slabs keep one big rounded corner (about 48 units at 1920) beside the cut.
Light grey #EFEFEF ground; one acid yellow-green is the only strong colour (15-22% of a section); black is the top bar, the pager, the stripe bands and the capsules.

Sections are numbered 01-06; each has a three-line title on one edge: ultra-black CJK, condensed Latin caps, a giant condensed two-digit number (ink heights 1 : 0.42 : 2.6-2.9), sitting on acid or grey, alternating left and right; the first screen has none.
Content sits in a white or picture slab with a big rounded corner and one 49-degree cut that faces the title, parallel to the acid slab's cut with a stripe band (about 196 units) between them.
A right-edge vertical pager: a black bar with round inner corners, acid to-previous and to-next marks around the current number set sideways, the next number half visible below.

Controls are capsules: white for the current page, acid for the one CTA, dark with a 6-unit grey ring for 'more'; carousels are a dark capsule track with round arrows, the current thumb framed in acid; dots are black, the current acid with a black ring.

Motifs: a film strip crosses between sections at 49 degrees; huge ghost letters (a name) sit behind slabs; one tilted sticker word with an offset black plate and invented pseudo-glyphs under it is the loudest CTA.

procedural: 49-degree fine stripes (3.9 on 13.2 units) clipped to a band, film strips with rounded sprocket holes, rounded slabs with one cut (rp in layouts-street.cjs)
the placeholder brand sticker: a cassette mark with two reels and rewind triangles (no letter shapes)
invented pseudo-glyphs under a sticker word; round arrow buttons; capsule controls
recipes: A slab picture with print grain: materials generate --generator halftone --params '{"periodPx":15,"angleDeg":45,"coverage":0.35}' --seed 1, laid at 35-55% over a placeholder or a picture (the case's video and gacha frames).

Characters and key art come from an image-generation task sheet (#311): materials request --template kv.tape-hero writes one from the template's layer contract (figure at least 2x its largest slot, transparent or a plain keyed backdrop, light from the upper left with a near-white rim, the palette, references by name, original characters only); the result is recorded with materials add --kind generated, cut with materials cut --mode grabcut and joined with materials composite (integration: sticker by default).
collage: Pictures sit only inside slabs or rounded cards; nothing small is written on a picture without a dark caption bar under it.
materials.sources: Everything is drawn; pictures are your own art in the image slots.

grammar: Scroll drives the pager: the current number swaps by a hard cut when a section crosses 45% of the viewport; nav capsules follow.
Carousel changes slide 24 units and fade in 0.18-0.25 s; thumbs lift 3 units on hover; the CTA capsule lifts 1 unit and gains a dark ring.
The sticker CTA rotates 3 degrees toward level and scales 1.04 on hover; nothing else tilts.
motion.flashLimit: No flashing; the news carousel advances every 6.5 s and pauses on hover.

integration.note: How a generated character joins street-tape scenes (#311). Sticker is the default: in a flat inked grammar a photographic or painterly figure still reads as pasted after a painted grade (prototype: mean dE 21.5 -> 13.6, yet visibly a photo in an illustration), while the die-cut edge turns any figure into the site's sticker vocabulary. Pixel values are for a 1080 px short side.

figure.rendering: flat cel shading with two shadow steps and black ink outlines of varying weight (main line 6-8 px at 2048 px wide), street-fashion clothing (technical jacket, loose workwear, platform shoes, headphones), a few halftone and sticker accents
references: Shibuya and Mong Kok night signage density (props)

guidance: 64 px distinctiveness (guidance): shrink each screen to 64 px tall beside a generic landing page with the logo masked; the grey ground, the acid slab with its 49-degree cut and the stripe band should still read. A dark-led page reads as the acid-print HUD instead.
Never set a mixed CJK and Latin string in Anton or Oswald: the browser fills the CJK glyphs from another face (glyph-coverage); use head or body.
A logo lockup (CJK name over Latin name) is one block: give both lines one data-grp prefix (logo/zh, logo/en) or keep a 3-unit gap.
A capsule that holds an icon, a value and a plus is three units, each with its own data-chk, or the check measures the icon colour against the capsule.
checks.note: The browser check runs on every render (stripes, film strips and the tilted sticker are measured in pixels).
